reviews.title: Impossible to drink from the straw
reviews.body: Spent $12+ on this but can't use it. So difficult to drink from the straw. Keep sucking with this much force = headache. Apparently you have to bite the straw while sucking cause this is a kid's tumbler and that's what kids do? Ridiculous!
